name: xml_comment
title: Marks text that xml_add_child inserts as a comment

origin.description: Marks text that xml_add_child inserts as a comment.
origin.example: x <- xml_new_document(); r <- xml_add_child(x, "root"); xml_add_child(r, xml_comment("Hello!")); paste(capture.output(x), collapse = "\n")

translation.description: Marks text that xml_add_child inserts as a comment.
translation.example: x = xml_new_document(); r = xml_add_child(x, "root"); xml_add_child(r, xml_comment("Hello!")); str(xml_root(x))
